newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom indicated at 31-34 marks.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom indicated at 31-34 marks.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG were on Monday trading at between 31 and 34 marks each, according to an official estimate issued by the Frankfurt stock exchange ahead of a full price quotation due later.
Deutsche Telekom's issue price had on Sunday been set at 28.50 marks each. An official price quotation is due from the Frankfurt bourse at around 1130 GMT.

Under the trading system used by the Frankfurt bourse, 31 marks represents the "bid" price at which investors are seeking to buy shares and 34 marks the "ask" price at which shares are on offer for sale.
